units: <cite ref="Pesachim 39b:16">Pes. 39ᵇ</cite> <he>שאינן באין לידי ח׳</he> which will not ferment (so as to become <cite ref="H01212"><he>חָמֵץ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Pesachim 39b:16">Ib.</cite>, sq. (in Chald. diction) <he>ואתי לידי ח׳</he> and may ferment.
<cite ref="Beitzah 7b:8">Bets. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>שחִמּוּצוֹ קשה</he> which is a strong leavening agent.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Challah 1:1:5">Y. Ḥall. I, beg. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>אין חִימּוּצוֹ חמץ ברור</he> the fermentation which it produces is not real leavening.
Nidd. 63ᵃ כמה חִמּוּצָן how long must urin stand to be considered as fermenting?—Pl. חִימּוּצִין salads, v. חוּמְצָן.
